definition: Unclear or doubtful in meaning, character, or truth.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: Laura Lyons, of equivocal reputation, a long step will have been made towards clearing one incident in this chain of mysteries.
example_sentence: His equivocal answer left us none the wiser.
